title: Use as an app
intro: Open from your desktop, tablet or phone home screen.
installHint: In a supported browser, choose Install app or Add to Home Screen from its menu.
browserGuide: Use this browser’s menu to add the app.
offlineHint: Store only the app screens, translations and programs in this browser. Local pages use the content already on this device.
privateBoundary: Account content, searches, attachments, login details and API responses are excluded. Collaboration and account saves require a connection.
consent: I have reviewed saving the screens and programs in this browser.
ready: Screens are ready for the next launch.
waiting: An update is ready. Close all tabs for this app, then open it again to apply it.
disabled: Stored screens were removed. Close open tabs to stop offline startup. Your local notes are preserved.
failed: Preparation failed. Check your connection and browser storage settings, then try again.
unsupported: Offline startup is unavailable here. Use HTTPS or localhost and a supported browser.
otherWorker: Another offline app uses this URL. Ask the administrator to check the URL setup.
offlineIntro: This page requires a server connection. Account content has not been saved for offline use.
online: When the connection returns, reload the original page.
updateHint: An update never automatically reloads a screen while you are writing.
localeFallbackNotice: Some labels use English. Page names and content are not translated.
